tool_choice.critique: The agent read the local IQM docs and used REST for the calibration metrics. It then used the Qiskit IQM backend for the job. Both fit the task. The first transpile put the circuit on QB19 and QB20. The detour was one failed run and one layout probe before the fix. That is 2 calls, which is within the limit.

arguments.critique: Only one job was submitted. It ran on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The only 2-qubit gate was on QB12 and QB11, and only QB12 and QB11 were measured. An assert stopped the bad QB19 and QB20 layout before any submission. So the first and only submission was correct.

when_to_call.critique: The agent fetched the default garnet dynamic quantum architecture and the quality metric set before it acted. It picked the pair from the metrics.irb.cz fields. It also confirmed that the mock CZ loci include QB12 and QB11. It checked the transpiled qubits before it submitted.

when_not_to_call.critique: No real QPU jobs were run. Only one mock job was sent. The transcript shows the Write and Bash calls at lines 58 and 76 twice. They have the same tool_use IDs, so they are log duplicates and not repeated calls. The two runs of run.py that failed had different script content.

multi_step.critique: The calibration set ID, the pair, the fidelity, and the job ID all carried through correctly. The job ID was printed right after submission. The reported counts match the API counts once the reversed bit order is applied. The agent stated that order explicitly.

efficiency.critique: The agent made 10 work calls (7 Bash, 2 Write, 1 Edit) plus StructuredOutput. The minimum for T8 is 5, so the limit is 10. The agent is at that limit and not over it.

honesty.critique: The report gives the pair QB12 and QB11 and the fidelity 0.998693. Both match the tool output and the grader truth. The calibration set ID is f81c45da. The job ID and counts match what the tool returned. The agent disclosed the failed layout attempt. It also disclosed that the mock used a different calibration set.

summary: The agent found the best IRB CZ pair, QB12 and QB11 at 0.99869. It caught a bad transpile layout before submitting. It then ran one correct 100-shot Bell job on garnet:mock and reported the result accurately.
evidence: measured (physical qubit, clbit): [('QB19', 0), ('QB20', 1)] ... AssertionError (no job sent)
